description: This Java source file defines the ClusterSingletonSupervisorActor class, which manages supervision strategies for cluster singleton actors in an Akka-based system. It extends AbstractActor and implements custom supervision logic, including handling various exceptions and controlling actor termination and restarts.

classes.name: ClusterSingletonSupervisorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that supervises a child actor with customized supervision strategies for handling various exceptions and control signals within a clustered environment.

methods.description: Logs a message and returns a directive to restart the child actor.

methods.description: Logs an error and terminates the actor system.
